rust_summary: spawning and removing session-scoped mannequins owned by a native mod.
doc_summary: Spawn an immovable, invulnerable mannequin with `host.spawn_mannequin(x, y, z, yaw, uuid, pose)`, and remove your own with `host.remove_spawned_entity(id)`. Each helper is limited to 512 calls per mod per authoritative server tick. Bundles need fragment @API:mannequin_corpse@.
